runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game nba_802 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --ready-timeout 90 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/stern/nba-2009-bumper-sling-probe.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Every public switch write is a short host pulse, never a ROM observation. Each bumper hit fires its own coil and lamp (30: Q9 and lamp 60; 31: Q10 and lamp 61; 32: Q11 and lamp 62), the shaker Q8 and the pop-bumper flash Q31; each slingshot hit fires its own coil (26: Q17; 27: Q18) and the slingshot flash Q32. The first top-bumper hit also coincides with the disk motor Q6 and relay Q22 and the orbit post Q21, which the ROM drives on its own timing.

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted key pulses; every retained DMD frame cited here was read visually and each diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is that reading of its pixel SHA-256.
